approvers: Main contractor would have to specify it; I sign suppliers myself
reason: I pay about €4,300 a year for snagging damage, and you want €19 per m² up front, which on 1,000 m² is more than four times what the damage costs me. I buy on cost per m² and I'm not paying that on jobs where the main contractor won't cover it.
objection: It costs far more than the damage it prevents, and I've never seen it used on a job in Malta. Nobody is asking me for it.
instead: Keep doing nothing, or use cheap film and tape on the odd high-end job, and clean or replace at snagging from contingency.
would_change_my_mind: A main contractor or developer who specifies it and pays for it as a line item, plus a local reference job.
